verdict.rationale: Orb's first-party docs describe a real-time webhooks system that calls an endpoint of your choosing when certain events occur, which delivers the core of subscribing to events. Threshold alerts (orb-docs-6, orb-docs-29) suggest relevant triggerable events, but the evidence never says they are delivered by webhook. Missing for 10: documented event-type catalog, signature verification and retry/delivery guarantees, programmatic (API) webhook subscription management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
